Describe projects and tasks.

Usage:
  mani describe [command]

Aliases:
  describe, desc

Examples:
  # Describe all projects
  mani describe projects

  # Describe all tasks
  mani describe tasks

Available Commands:
  projects    Describe projects
  tasks       Describe tasks

Flags:
  -h, --help           help for describe
      --theme string   set theme (default "default")

Global Flags:
      --color                enable color (default true)
  -c, --config string        specify config
  -u, --user-config string   specify user config

Use "mani describe [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Documentation: https://manicli.com
Issues:        https://github.com/alajmo/mani/issues
